name: Development Media International (Founders Pledge)
beneficiaries_note: The countries the model's summary names: Burkina Faso.

missing_data.note: Measured: DMI's own randomised trial of the same radio campaigns (Burkina Faso) measured the behaviour change; Founders Pledge's discount on the modelled deaths calibrates to that trial and stays.

summary: Radio campaigns that encourage parents to take sick children to a health facility, based on DMI's trial in Burkina Faso. A re-implementation of Founders Pledge's November 2022 back-of-the-envelope estimate in its mass media report, which counts illness and child deaths from diarrhoea, pneumonia and malaria averted through extra treatment, in WELLBY-equivalents, over three scenarios for how long the effect lasts.

Discounting (our lever inside Founders Pledge's scenarios)
sections.explainer: These rows feed Founders Pledge's scenarios, so they sit in its part of the model, but the lever is ours: the shared discount rate (Your values) is added to Founders Pledge's own scenario rates. Founders Pledge's notes describe those rates as diminishing effects or as access spreading anyway, not as later good counting less. The evaluator view pins our rate at 0, so Founders Pledge's numbers reproduce.

sections.title: Back to healthy years
sections.explainer: charityevals' step: Founders Pledge states its result as a multiple of GiveDirectly at $164 per WELLBY-equivalent; divided by that and by its 3.7 WELLBY-equivalents per healthy year, it is healthy years (DALYs) per dollar.

sections.title: Staff pay below market
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, not Founders Pledge's: with credit by share of resources on, staff's pay below what they could earn elsewhere counts as an in-kind contribution and gets its share of the outcome. Off by default.

rows.label: WELLBY-equivalents per child death averted (in Founders Pledge units)

source.title: Founders Pledge, Mass media BOTECs: DMI childhood mortality, November 2022

rows.explainer: Changed for consistency. Founders Pledge values averting a child's death at 234 WELLBY-equivalents (63 healthy years at its 3.7 WELLBY-equivalents per healthy year). The site values every death averted with one shared figure, so that a life saved counts the same in every model: GiveWell's moral weights, 116.25 units of value (a unit of value is a doubled income for a year), times the weight on a life under Your values. Here that value is written in Founders Pledge's units so the steps below can stay as Founders Pledge built them: 116.25 units of value, divided by the rate between a healthy year and a doubled-income year (Your values), times Founders Pledge's 3.7. The step back to healthy years divides the 3.7 out again, so each death counts 116.25 / 2 = 58 healthy years at the default, whatever Founders Pledge's WELLBY rate. The evaluator view uses Founders Pledge's 234.

Discount rate on future years (ours)
rows.explainer: Our lever, not Founders Pledge's: the shared discount rate (Your values). Founders Pledge's own rates in these scenarios are explained in its notes as diminishing effects (or, for FEM's 8%, as contraceptive access spreading anyway), so we read them as the effect fading and apply ours on top. The evaluator view pins it at 0, so Founders Pledge's numbers reproduce.

Founders Pledge's value per dollar (WELLBY-equivalents)
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's multiple of GiveDirectly divided by its $164 per WELLBY for GiveDirectly: the multiple back in its value units.

rows.label: Healthy years (DALY-equivalents) per dollar
rows.explainer: charityevals' step. Founders Pledge's 2022 'WELLBYs' are its own unit of value, built from its moral weights (3.7 per healthy year, 1.9 per doubled income-year), not life-satisfaction points measured in surveys, so they are not converted at the WELLBY exchange rate. Every benefit here was counted in healthy years and multiplied by 3.7, so dividing by 3.7 gives the healthy years back.
